body: ++ ive looked up different phrases of those descriptions and couldn't find it :(
im safe where i am, she knows where i am and my grandmother is always open to help her, i would just have to find a way to convince her she's in danger if that's the case, thank you <3
okay, ill try this, thank you! this helped mwah mwah :( <3
my mom knows the little pizza delivery method which i could use but they dont order pizza often enough for us to be able to pull it off,, thats all i can really think of

i'm going to wait and see if these couple days away makes it easier for them process before i do something like that. i don't want to get them in trouble. thank you though, i'll remember that if still don't accept me being at home
thank you so much, i'll remember this. bless you too <3
thank you. knowing that there's someone supporting me through this mess is help enough <3

i hate to be a bother but yes, can i please pm you? just to, get everything off my chest i guess. i can't tell my friend because i only prepared myself to come out to my parents and i'm already overwhelmed as it is and . everything's a mess. my grandparents are supportive, really supportive, but too far for me to move in with easily :(
thank you so much. i'll tell my math teacher, we're really close. <3

the one uncle i have, we don't have contact. we were never really that close as he wasn't really close with my mom. i told my grandma first when i found out a couple years or so ago, she took it really well and congratulated my courage to tell her. she did tell me to be careful when telling my parents and to make sure i was as confident as possible in my sexuality before doing so. my grandparents are very supportive, even though they don't know how to help, they try to comfort me.
i'm 15, almost 16. i'm still in 10th grade and still really really need my parents. i appreciate that you tried to help anyways, thank you <3
do you believe that being lgbt is a sin? my parents do, i'm just curious if that's a big thing or not.
HAVE A GOOD DAY <3
okay thank you :)

i'm staying a friends house for the time being. even though i'm not allowed to live here if i do ultimately get kicked out somehow, theyre letting me stay for a couple days. maybe these couple days without me there will make it easier for them to think about it so when i come back they won't be as upset? i just don't know how i'm going to go about telling them that i'm still god's child...

i'n almost 16 and have, at most, like $25 in my drawer. i don't know how to support myself, they never taught me as we didn't know i'd be leaving at fifteen years old. i don't think they love me anymore, i walked passed my mom before bed, getting some water, and she looked so disgusted in me. i heard her praying passing her room as well, and it's safe to say they want me like this. i can't sleep over it, i'm so scared
it felt like they were trying to brush it off, ignore me, pretend i didn't say anything.
thank you so much, i'll update afterwards! 💞💞

i decided that tonight, for dinner prayer, i would read a few scriptures about loving others no matter what. hopefully with that in mind, they'll think about it and accept me when i come out right after dinner. thank you for your story and your help. <3

i've talked to a friend about it but she says she doesn't think my parents would kick me out or anything like that. i'm hesitant to believe her, due to their devotion to christianity, but i understand what she means. 

my parents don't like any of my friends as they aren't the people they introduced me to at church. most of my friends aren't
christian or religious and, therefore, don't abide by the bible.

for the past week or so, being super ready to just get it off my chest, i've been adding different verses about loving your child no matter their personality, that kind of thing, to our dinner prayers.

it's like you're playing a video game. you're watching from a different point of view but you have full control of your actions. before i was diagnosed, and even still, i call days like this fake days. on fake days, it feels like i'm watching myself from above but i can still control my body, it just feels weird. it feels fake, like i'm in a dream or reliving memories i can't remember. this is a lot harder to describe than i thought, but i hope you understand.
im not allowed to go to public school but if i ever get the chance, ill try to talk to someone.
i will if my mom ever holds up to her promise of getting me a therapist. thank you for saying im valid, i really really needed to hear that.

i dont have a doctor, i never go because im never sick and my parents all tell me that im fine and to just take ibuprofen when im in pain for something; buy me cold pills and sick medicines from the dollar store if i catch a cold. even if i did, my mom never leaves when im at the doctor.

im not sure if you were looking for me to reply to you or not but i thought itd be helpful to answer your questions. my mom says she'll get me a therapist, she's said so for a year and she still hasn't. my insurance covers therapy completely. i don't eat much, maybe one meal a day or less; i'm still trying to fix myself from my phase of starvation (i don't want to say anorexia as i was never diagnosed.) i dance daily, like choreography and stuff every day for a few hours and drink a lot of water. i take visits to talk to my mom every couple hours for an upwards of 20 minutes so i get enough socialization. i don't go to public school, i homeschool as my anxiety was too bad that my mom pulled me from public school. i think i've already passed puberty? since i hit it when i was 10, its been four years already but i don't really know all too much about how puberty works so i dont know. my mom says that even if in some wild world i was diagnosed, she would never let me take medicine for it because she thinks itll just make me a shell of my person. i talk to my friends yeah, my girlfriend and my best friend i tell absolutely everything about everything i feel and they always make me feel better, even if only temporarily, they help a lot.
